properties.name: The gate that says every declared property has a typed writer reads which TOOL writes which TYPE, not which names happen to match
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word, and it is the one with the strongest evidence in flo2's report. The reachability gate reported zero holes on a tree where `Requirement.kind` and `Verification.location` had no typed writer at all — and `Requirement.kind` is read by a detector that scolds flo2's users on their own page. MEASURED: the gate attaches every parameter of all 54 tools it cannot place to EVERY node type, 109 names in all, so `kind` is excused by forecast_readiness and gate_on and `location` by register_alternative. 24 of 238 declared properties rest on that pool alone. THE OBLIGATION: a tool's parameters count toward a type only when that tool writes that type, the gate refuses a tool it cannot place rather than pooling it, and the two known holes are closed with a `kind` on add_requirement and a `location` on add_verification.
